githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.7 Beta 1 fixes a crash introduced in v0.1.6 that could occur while a server member list was open with server tags enabled.

## Member list stability

- Fixed a crash when server tags scrolled out of view in the member list. Server tags can remain enabled; disabling them in Accessibility is no longer needed as a workaround.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.6...v0.1.7-Beta-1](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.6...v0.1.7-Beta-1)
discordAnnouncement:
**Server-tag crash fix 🌙**

Fixed a crash when server tags scrolled out of view in the member list. You can leave server tags enabled—disabling them in Accessibility is no longer needed as a workaround.
